title: SCHC draft names generic legacy vectors as canonical and profile vector says Version 2
description: test/vectors/schc_fragmentation.json is the fixed-profile Rule 0x78/0x79 dataset but its description still says Rule Set Version 2. The SCHC draft instead names schc_fragment.json alone as the canonical ACK-on-Error oracle, although that legacy/generic dataset includes non-profile Rule 0x2a and toy tile/window parameters. Update the profile vector metadata to Version 3 and make draft/README references distinguish the generic codec vectors from the normative LICHEN fixed-profile fragmentation vectors; do not claim all implementations must accept non-profile parameters in production.
